title: Product Manifest Schema
description: Manifest representing a product and its declared services

id.description: Stable unique product identifier in lowercase-kebab-case

description.description: Brief description of the product and its purpose

docs.description: Relative path to product documentation reference (e.g. README.md or docs/overview.md)

services.description: Declared services owned by this product

manifest.description: Relative path to service.yaml from the product manifest directory
